item.title: VoxelWall 1.0.35
item.description:
Latest wallpaper takes over cleanly.

VoxelWall 1.0.35 makes the newly downloaded wallpaper replace the previous renderer immediately, without overlapping two wallpapers or opening Wallpaper Settings unnecessarily.

This release also refreshes all 37 current wallpaper packages with the latest rendering and display-fit improvements. The wallpaper library size remains unchanged.

item.title: VoxelWall 1.0.34
item.description:
Smoother wallpaper control.

VoxelWall 1.0.34 makes it easier to fine-tune a wallpaper after it is active. You can switch between Subtle, Balanced, Intense, and Energy Saver, then apply the new setting without restarting setup.

This update also improves reliability when the latest wallpaper version takes over on your desktop and Lock Screen.

item.title: VoxelWall 1.0.33
item.description:
Reliable wallpaper updates.

VoxelWall 1.0.33 keeps desktop and Lock Screen setup status accurate while macOS finishes applying a wallpaper, and delivers signed, versioned wallpaper updates with a safe fallback.

This release improves rendering across display aspect ratios and adds ultra-wide Saver media for all 37 current wallpapers.

item.title: VoxelWall 1.0.32
item.description:
Smoother live wallpapers, in English.

VoxelWall 1.0.32 refines English wording throughout the app and improves the performance of Voxel Vortex, Clay Starwell, and Liquid Starfold.

Your wallpaper library remains unchanged: this release keeps all 37 current wallpapers.

item.title: VoxelWall 1.0.31
item.description:
Clearer wallpaper setup.

VoxelWall 1.0.31 improves wallpaper installation feedback and rendering reliability, so it is easier to tell when a scene is ready.

This update also includes stability improvements across wallpaper switching and downloads.
